messages:
maya_support: heads up — support case from AcmeCorp showing intermittent 401s on the API (mostly POST /v1/generate) after yesterday's key rotation. stack traces include JWT_SIGNATURE_INVALID and a few TOKEN_EXPIRED entries. request ids: rq_8b3f, rq_8b4a, rq_8b78. customers are blocked.

maya_support: repro timeline: around 02:12 UTC we rotated signing keys, then ~02:18 some traffic started failing for a subset of requests. failures continued ~02:18–02:45, then gradually dropped off.

maya_support: logs (redacted):
```
ERROR verify_jwt failed kid not found, token.kid="k-2026-01" req_id=rq_8b3f
ERROR verify_jwt signature invalid token.kid="k-2025-old" req_id=rq_8b4a
WARN token expired iat=1712349000 exp=1712349600 now=1712349705 req_id=rq_8b78
```

maya_support: headers (example):
```
Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
x-request-id: rq_8b3f
```

maya_support: customer says they didn't change anything client-side. they called support and showed current token payload with kid==k-2026-01.

ana_engsec: thanks — this looks like a JWKS cache + clock-skew mix. two hypotheses: 1) some serving nodes still had old JWKS cached and couldn't find the new kid; 2) tokens near expiry failed due to small clock skew on some nodes.

ana_engsec: repro steps for eng to reproduce locally:
1) start a verifier with JWKS endpoint pointing to a static file (simulate cached old keys).
2) generate a JWT signed with the new private key and kid=k-2026-01.
3) call verifier — it should return kid not found.

Command examples:
```
# generate a token (node + jose)
node -e "const jose=require('jose'); (async()=>{const pk=/* new private key PEM */; const j=await new jose.SignJWT({sub:'acct-123'}).setProtectedHeader({alg:'RS256', kid:'k-2026-01'}).setIssuedAt().setExpirationTime('2m').sign(jose.JWK.asKey(pk)); console.log(j)})()"

# verifier (curl) against service
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

tj_sre: quick note — some infra VMs were 10–30s behind NTP for ~45m during that window (we have drift detection alerts but they were noisy and muted). that explains the TOKEN_EXPIRED hits. will re-enable stricter drift alerts after fix.

ana_engsec: recommended short-term mitigations:
- implement "refresh on kid-miss": when verify fails with kid-not-found, fetch latest JWKS once and retry verification (no infinite loops).
- add a small clock-skew tolerance by default (+/-120s) in token validation.
- on 401 with kid-miss, return a structured header like `WWW-Authenticate: error=invalid_token, error_description="kid_not_found; jwks_refreshed"` to let clients/backends know we retried.

ana_engsec: suggested patch (pseudocode):
```
function verify_jwt(token){
  claims = decode(token)
  kid = claims.header.kid
  key = jwks_cache.get(kid)
  if(!key){
    // try one refresh
    jwks_cache.refresh()
    key = jwks_cache.get(kid)
    if(!key) throw new AuthError('kid_not_found')
  }
  // verify with skew allowed
  return jwt.verify(token, key, {clockTolerance:120})
}
```

luis_product: for customer comms — is there a plan for a hotfix + postmortem? they want ETA and to know if any data was exposed.

maya_support: customer asked about exposure — we confirmed no private key leak; this is purely verification mismatch. communicated that to AcmeCorp but they want a timeline.

tj_sre: action plan from infra: force NTP resync on all nodes, enable and fix drift alerting. I'll run a rolling restart of the verifier pods once the verification code changes are merged to ensure no stale in-memory JWKS.

ana_engsec: ops plan from eng-sec: prepare a small patch for verifier library (refresh-on-miss + 120s skew) — target: hotfix to prod in the next 3 hours. add metric jwt_verification_failures_by_reason with tag 'kid_not_found' and 'signature_invalid' so we can graph post-deploy. also instrument jwks_refresh_count.

dev_deploybot: :gear: deployment queued: canary to 2 pods in prod-region-1. will watch 5m then promote.

ana_engsec: longer term: we should implement proactive JWKS fanout on rotation — push notifications (webhook/stream) to all verifier instances to invalidate caches immediately. also make key rotation transactional: publish JWKS first, then rotate signing, with a short overlap window.

tj_sre: repro checklist for on-call to validate the fix:
- simulate key rotation with jwks endpoint updated and old keys TTL set high.
- issue token with new kid, ensure verify succeeds after refresh-on-miss.
- simulate 30s clock skew, ensure tokens within 120s window still accepted.

maya_support: notes for support reply to customer: apologize, explain root cause (intermittent verification failures during key rotation + clock drift on some nodes), list mitigations (hotfix deploying: JWKS refresh on kid-miss, small clock-skew tolerance, infra NTP resync), ETA ~3h for canary then full rollout.

luis_product: please include a short postmortem and customer-facing blurb after deploy. track SLA impact and billing credits if needed.

ana_engsec: I'll own the postmortem. after deploy we should keep the metric panel open and verify jwt_verification_failures_by_reason drops to baseline.

maya_support: thanks — I'll update the case and send the ETA. if anyone sees new rq ids with the same errors, paste them here.

tj_sre: will follow up after NTP resync and canary validation.

(reacts: :rotating_light: from maya_support, :white_check_mark: from dev_deploybot)
